answer: Throttle the front gate. Each epoch the network admits only 40 new earning keys, drawn by beacon lottery from a public waiting lagoon, and a waiting key must answer every epoch unpaid to keep its place. A farm that floods 2,000 keys needs 50 epochs before its last key earns, paying compute for all of them meanwhile. Every admission lands on a public atlas of join dates, so clones that sprouted together like yarrow after rain get audited as one batch.
